description: Round-2 readings (2026-10-14): which speed and range are right, ACC target fields, 0x680, 0x196 bytes 4-7. Drives anonymised; numbers from the research workspace (exploratory unless stated).

speed_gain_standstill.scope: ego stopped, lead moving off; owner drives

far_range_against_odometry.scope: approaches to stopped cars starting at 60-80 m, two cars, ego <= 16 m/s, 20 episodes; GNSS-scaled wheel odometry, 0.15 s output age
far_range_against_odometry.object_list_median_m: -0.8 (anchored at the stop) to -3.1 (anchored at 30 m); first run -1.46
far_range_against_odometry.note: each stream anchored on itself: tests the range scale on stopped cars, not an absolute zero; list result is anchor-dependent

far_range_list_vs_acc.relative_gap_beyond_45m_by_ego_speed: -2 to -5 % at every ego speed 10-40 m/s, no step

acc_lat_speed.wrap_cause: crossing traffic 12.8-20 m/s, 14 of 16 at ego standstill

obj680_is_track0.note: same car whenever ID 0 (173/173 original-log recheck, 6/6 third car); ranges are a close copy (tight copy 171/173), few moving-vehicle frames

a196_bytes_4_7.reading: byte6-byte4 / byte7-byte5 = lateral distance to left / right corridor edge
a196_bytes_4_7.note: owner car only; fit does not transfer to the second car (R2 negative), lateral / TTC alternatives compete

range_output_age_vs_odometry.scope: 21 braking approaches to stopped cars, original logs, ranges 3-60 m, carState odometry
